map_disagreements.why: The single most valuable disagreement in this deck. Six cards read the SAME input - an opponent drew a card, or cast a spell - and each states a different OUTPUT, so the map, which is built from card text, files them by what they produce. Smothering Tithe reads as a tap-room card because it says Treasure. Heliod reads as your own board because his type line is a creature. Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Consecrated Sphinx and Faerie Mastermind read as the gift economy. No card in the group says what the group is for, so this layer is invisible in card text and cannot be seen by a reader looking at the constellation. The v1.2.1 run makes the case for grouping them: 2,322 trigger lines off one shared event.

26 cards across five cities - the map splits them by HOW they answer (counter text, destroy text, a body, a Treasure rider on An Offer You Can't Refuse) while the deck uses all of them for one job: buy turns until you can cast a seven-drop twice.
